name: FirstRand Limited
source: FirstRand audited consolidated annual financial statements 2026 (consolidated income statement, page B28) | CRON 2026-10-13: FY2026 Profit Before Tax and Income Tax completed from FirstRand's own audited consolidated income statement for the year ended 30 June 2026 (page B28) with the two operations summed, which is the basis the FY2025 column of this file already uses. Printed lines: profit before income tax from continuing operations 53 640, income tax expense (11 727), discontinued operations profit before income tax (2 494) and its income tax expense (161), profit for the year 39 258. Summing the two operations gives Profit Before Tax 51 146 and Income Tax 11 888, and 51 146 less 11 888 equals the printed profit for the year 39 258. The earlier FY2026 cell of 11 727 was the continuing operations tax alone and was replaced so the two years share one basis (FY2025 11 473 continuing plus 1 273 discontinued equals the stored 12 746). Net Profit for FY2026 stays 37 468 as stored, the face line profit attributable to equityholders of the group; profit for the year of 39 258 less that 37 468 is the 1 790 printed for non-controlling interests. Figures in SA rand, converted from R million. Source: https://www.firstrand.co.za/media/investors/reports/firstrand-annual-financial-statements-2026.pdf
source_note: FY2026 column read from the issuer audited consolidated income statement for the year ended 30 June 2026 (page B28): Operating expenses 79,942m. Net Finance Costs and Profit Before Tax intentionally left blank: the stored Profit Before Tax and Net Profit sit on different bases (continuing operations versus equityholders including the discontinued Aldermore operation), so no figure is written that would not tie.
